issues.title: Make main function return int instead of calling sys.exit directly

body.current_state: main calls sys.exit with result.success directly, making it difficult to test without catching SystemExit
body.problem: Cannot test main function without catching SystemExit exception, which is awkward and can mask real errors
body.proposed_solution: Change main to return int exit code, move sys.exit call to if __name__ == __main__ block
body.success_criteria: main returns int, tests can call main directly and assert on return value

issues.title: Move __version__ import to top-level with fallback

body.current_state: from .__version__ import __version__ is inside main function
body.problem: Import failure not caught; harder to mock in tests; deferred import adds complexity
body.proposed_solution: Move import to top-level with try/except fallback to 0.0.0 for robustness
body.success_criteria: Version import at module level with graceful fallback if __version__.py missing

issues.title: Add validation for editor parameter in install_global method

body.current_state: install_global with invalid editor silently proceeds and returns confusing error message
body.problem: Invalid editor values produce unclear error messages instead of immediate validation failure
body.proposed_solution: Validate editor parameter against SUPPORTED_EDITORS set; raise ValueError for invalid values
body.success_criteria: install_global with invalid editor raises ValueError with clear message listing valid options

issues.title: Use constant for default editor fallback instead of magic string

body.current_state: return Code hardcoded as magic string fallback
body.problem: If SUPPORTED_EDITORS list changes, hardcoded fallback may become invalid; magic string reduces maintainability
body.proposed_solution: Define DEFAULT_EDITOR = Code as class constant; use SUPPORTED_EDITORS last item or constant for fallback
body.success_criteria: No hardcoded Code string; fallback derived from SUPPORTED_EDITORS constant

issues.title: Consolidate LOCAL_FILES and GLOBAL_FILES source path duplication

body.current_state: LOCAL_FILES and GLOBAL_FILES both define same src_relative paths with different dst_relative paths
body.problem: If source filename changes, must update in two places; DRY violation increases maintenance burden
body.proposed_solution: Define SOURCE_FILES list once; generate LOCAL_FILES and GLOBAL_FILES mappings from it with different destination patterns
body.success_criteria: Single source of truth for agent file names; mappings derived programmatically

issues.title: Add Business context to EditorDetector.__init__ docstring

body.current_state: Docstring has Args only, missing Business context line present in other methods
body.problem: Inconsistent documentation style across the codebase
body.proposed_solution: Add Business: Initializes editor detection for auto-selecting VS Code variant during global install. line
body.success_criteria: All __init__ methods follow same docstring pattern with Business context
